provenance.scope: One sentence, two at most, per work the museum shows: the one thing worth remembering. The line stands first on the card and at the head of the vitrine, before any description. The fifty-six dates keep their own sentences and are not written here.
provenance.rule: Every line rests on a document the wing's registers hold, named in `source`. A claim on a tradition carries the certainty word. A work whose registers hold no documented line has no record here and its reason stands in the seat's STATUS.
provenance.detail: A rectangle in the coordinates of the plate the picture module resolves for that work, as fractions of the plate's width and height from its top left. Present only where the line points at something on the surface. A line about a work's fate carries no rectangle.
provenance.sheets: A Windsor sheet's line speaks about the side that hangs. It rests on the holder's catalogue entry for that sheet and, where the entry is silent or missing, on the public domain Windsor anatomy facsimiles of 1898 and 1901, read against the reproduction on the wall.

picture/baptism-of-christ/front.en: New studies give him more of it, the Uffizi says. Christ, and the landscape behind him.
picture/baptism-of-christ/front.de: Neue Studien geben ihm mehr davon, so die Uffizien. Christus und die Landschaft dahinter.
picture/baptism-of-christ/front.source: MINING-CATALOG-PAINTINGS §1, the Baptism of Christ, the holder's entry on the attribution

picture/annunciation/front.en: It reached the Uffizi in 1867 as a Ghirlandaio. Two years later it was given to him.
picture/annunciation/front.de: 1867 kam sie als Ghirlandaio in die Uffizien. Zwei Jahre später galt sie als seine.

picture/ginevra-de-benci/front.en: Someone cut the bottom off this panel. Her arms and hands probably went with it.
picture/ginevra-de-benci/front.de: Jemand hat den unteren Rand abgeschnitten. Arme und Hände gingen wohl mit.

picture/ginevra-de-benci/reverse.en: This side carries a juniper sprig and the words VIRTVTEM FORMA DECORAT.
picture/ginevra-de-benci/reverse.de: Diese Seite trägt einen Wacholderzweig und die Worte VIRTVTEM FORMA DECORAT.

picture/madonna-of-the-carnation/front.en: The museum that owns it calls this picture Madonna mit der Nelke.
picture/madonna-of-the-carnation/front.de: Madonna mit der Nelke nennt sie das Museum, dem sie gehört.
picture/madonna-of-the-carnation/front.source: MINING-CATALOG-PAINTINGS, Madonna of the Carnation, label fact; the holder's own record

picture/benois-madonna/front.en: The Hermitage bought it in 1914, by instalments. It kept paying through the revolution.
picture/benois-madonna/front.de: Die Eremitage kaufte sie 1914 auf Raten. Auch durch die Revolution zahlte sie weiter.

picture/saint-jerome/front.en: A dealer sawed this panel up to sell the head alone. The pieces were joined again.
picture/saint-jerome/front.de: Ein Händler zersägte die Tafel, um den Kopf zu verkaufen. Die Teile kamen zurück.
picture/saint-jerome/front.source: MINING-CATALOG-PAINTINGS, Saint Jerome in the Wilderness, label fact

detail.name_en: The head that was sold alone
detail.name_de: Der Kopf, der einzeln verkauft wurde

picture/adoration-of-the-magi/front.en: He left it unfinished in 1482 and went to Milan. The charcoal drawing is still visible.
picture/adoration-of-the-magi/front.de: 1482 ließ er sie unvollendet und ging nach Mailand. Die Kohlezeichnung ist sichtbar.
picture/adoration-of-the-magi/front.source: MINING-CATALOG-PAINTINGS, Adoration of the Magi, commission and the holder's record

picture/annunciation-predella/front.en: This altar step is sixteen centimetres high. Whose hand painted it is still argued.
picture/annunciation-predella/front.de: Die Tafel unter dem Altarbild ist sechzehn Zentimeter hoch. Wer sie malte, ist strittig.
picture/annunciation-predella/front.source: MINING-CATALOG-PAINTINGS, the predella panel, holder's record and attribution

picture/virgin-of-the-rocks-louvre/front.en: A brotherhood ordered it in April 1483 and wanted it by that December.
picture/virgin-of-the-rocks-louvre/front.de: Eine Bruderschaft bestellte es im April 1483 und wollte es im Dezember haben.
picture/virgin-of-the-rocks-louvre/front.source: MINING-CATALOG-PAINTINGS, Virgin of the Rocks, Louvre version, commission

picture/portrait-of-a-musician/front.en: A cleaning in 1904 uncovered the hand and its music. He had been taken for a duke.
picture/portrait-of-a-musician/front.de: Eine Reinigung legte 1904 die Hand mit dem Notenblatt frei. Zuvor galt er als Herzog.
picture/portrait-of-a-musician/front.source: MINING-CATALOG-PAINTINGS, Portrait of a Musician, label fact

picture/lady-with-an-ermine/front.en: The black behind her is not his. Someone brushed it on in the 1700s, over a bluish grey.
picture/lady-with-an-ermine/front.de: Das Schwarz hinter ihr ist nicht von ihm. Es kam im 18. Jahrhundert über ein Blaugrau.
picture/lady-with-an-ermine/front.source: MINING-CATALOG-PAINTINGS, Lady with an Ermine, condition

picture/la-belle-ferronniere/front.en: The Louvre's own title calls the name La Belle Ferronniere a mistake.
picture/la-belle-ferronniere/front.de: Der Louvre nennt den Namen La Belle Ferronnière im eigenen Titel einen Irrtum.
picture/la-belle-ferronniere/front.source: MINING-CATALOG-PAINTINGS, La Belle Ferronniere, the holder's title

picture/madonna-litta/front.en: The count who sold it in 1865 gave it its name. Whether it is his is argued.
picture/madonna-litta/front.de: Den Namen gab ihr der Graf, der sie 1865 verkaufte. Ob sie von ihm stammt, ist strittig.
picture/madonna-litta/front.source: MINING-CATALOG-PAINTINGS, Madonna Litta, label fact and attribution

picture/burlington-house-cartoon/front.en: A shotgun blast hit it in 1987. The glass took most of it, and the sheet was restored.
picture/burlington-house-cartoon/front.de: 1987 fing das Glas das meiste eines Flintenschusses ab. Das Blatt wurde restauriert.
picture/burlington-house-cartoon/front.source: MINING-CATALOG-PAINTINGS, the Burlington House Cartoon, second label fact

picture/yarnwinder-buccleuch/front.en: Thieves took it from a Scottish castle in 2003. Nobody ever caught them.
picture/yarnwinder-buccleuch/front.de: Diebe holten sie 2003 aus einem schottischen Schloss. Gefasst wurde nie jemand.
picture/yarnwinder-buccleuch/front.source: MINING-CATALOG-PAINTINGS, Madonna of the Yarnwinder, Buccleuch version, label fact

picture/yarnwinder-lansdowne/front.en: The same drawing lies under both of them. Both came out of his workshop.
picture/yarnwinder-lansdowne/front.de: Unter beiden liegt dieselbe Zeichnung. Beide kamen aus seiner Werkstatt.
picture/yarnwinder-lansdowne/front.source: MINING-CATALOG-PAINTINGS, Madonna of the Yarnwinder, Lansdowne version, attribution

picture/anghiari-copy/front.en: The wall painting is lost. This sheet is a copy, worked over by several later hands.
picture/anghiari-copy/front.de: Das Wandbild ist verloren. Dieses Blatt ist eine Kopie, später von mehreren überarbeitet.
picture/anghiari-copy/front.source: MINING-CATALOG-PAINTINGS, the Battle of Anghiari, the holder's reading of the sheet

picture/mona-lisa/front.en: It was stolen from the Louvre in 1911. It was found in Florence two years later.
picture/mona-lisa/front.de: 1911 wurde sie aus dem Louvre gestohlen. Zwei Jahre später fand man sie in Florenz.
picture/mona-lisa/front.source: STAR-SOURCES §1, the taking of 21 August 1911 in the holder's 2021 dossier; the Florence state archive's records of December 1913, the police report of 13 December c. 2r and the declaration of the same day c. 22r

picture/virgin-of-the-rocks-london/front.en: Paris has the other one. They probably first stood side by side in 2011.
picture/virgin-of-the-rocks-london/front.de: Die andere Fassung hängt in Paris. 2011 standen sie wohl erstmals nebeneinander.
picture/virgin-of-the-rocks-london/front.source: MINING-CATALOG-PAINTINGS, Virgin of the Rocks, National Gallery version, label fact

picture/virgin-and-child-with-st-anne/fr.en: Two advisers resigned over the cleaning. They said it had been made too bright.
picture/virgin-and-child-with-st-anne/fr.de: Zwei Berater traten wegen der Reinigung zurück. Sie sei zu hell geworden, sagten sie.
picture/virgin-and-child-with-st-anne/fr.source: MINING-CATALOG-PAINTINGS, The Virgin and Child with Saint Anne, condition

picture/salvator-mundi/front.en: In 2005 it sold for 1,175 dollars. In 2017 it made 450 million.
picture/salvator-mundi/front.de: 2005 kostete es 1175 Dollar. 2017 brachte es 450 Millionen.

picture/saint-john-the-baptist/front.en: A visitor saw a young Saint John in this house in 1517. Nobody knows if it was this one.
picture/saint-john-the-baptist/front.de: 1517 sah ein Besucher hier einen jungen Johannes. Ob es dieser war, weiß niemand.
picture/saint-john-the-baptist/front.source: pictures/data/paintings.json, saint-john-the-baptist, the de Beatis entry with its inferred identification

picture/la-scapigliata/front.en: An inventory of 1627 calls it a dishevelled woman's head. It is the smallest of them.
picture/la-scapigliata/front.de: Ein Inventar von 1627 nennt sie den Kopf einer zerzausten Frau. Sie ist die kleinste.
picture/la-scapigliata/front.source: MINING-CATALOG-PAINTINGS, La Scapigliata, label fact and dimensions

picture/bacchus/front.en: It left the workshop as a Saint John. Someone later painted it into a Bacchus.
picture/bacchus/front.de: Es verließ die Werkstatt als Johannes. Später malte es jemand zu einem Bacchus um.

picture/last-supper/front.en: In 1943 bombs brought the hall's ceiling down. This wall stood, behind sandbags.
picture/last-supper/front.de: 1943 stürzte das Gewölbe unter Bomben ein. Diese Wand blieb stehen, hinter Sandsäcken.
picture/last-supper/front.source: MINING-CATALOG-PAINTINGS, the Last Supper's wall, room history

sheet/rcin-919000.en: The foot at the bottom of the sheet is drawn upside down. So are its leg bones.
sheet/rcin-919000.de: Der Fuß unten auf dem Blatt steht auf dem Kopf, samt den Beinknochen.
sheet/rcin-919000.source: Royal Collection catalogue entry, RCIN 919000; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919001.en: Down the right margin he gives advice. The more you keep away from doctors, the better.
sheet/rcin-919001.de: Am rechten Rand gibt er einen Rat. Je mehr du dich vor Ärzten hütest, desto gesünder.
sheet/rcin-919001.source: Windsor anatomy facsimile of 1898, fogli A, folio 2 recto, matched to this sheet by its notes; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919002.en: He wrote that nobody can swallow and breathe at the same time. Try it yourself.
sheet/rcin-919002.de: Niemand kann zugleich schlucken und atmen, schrieb er. Probier es an dir selbst.
sheet/rcin-919002.source: Royal Collection catalogue entry, RCIN 919002; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919003.en: Most of these drawings are of a living person. What he saw inside the dead is in them too.
sheet/rcin-919003.de: Meist zeichnete er hier einen Lebenden. Was er in Toten sah, steckt mit darin.
sheet/rcin-919003.source: Royal Collection catalogue entry, RCIN 919003; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919004.en: Between the thighbones he wrote that the tailbone moves in childbirth. He was right.
sheet/rcin-919004.de: Zwischen den Schenkelknochen steht: Bei der Geburt bewegt sich das Steißbein. So ist es.
sheet/rcin-919004.source: Royal Collection catalogue entry, RCIN 919004; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919005.en: The old man at the top appears dead. Some of these studies were probably made on him.
sheet/rcin-919005.de: Der alte Mann oben scheint tot zu sein. Einige dieser Studien entstanden wohl an ihm.
sheet/rcin-919005.source: Royal Collection catalogue entry, RCIN 919005, the recto; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919006.en: He drew the muscles between the ribs at the right. His note: they tie the ribs.
sheet/rcin-919006.de: Rechts zeichnete er die Muskeln zwischen den Rippen. Seine Notiz: Sie binden die Rippen.
sheet/rcin-919006.source: Royal Collection catalogue entry, RCIN 919006; Windsor anatomy facsimile of 1898, fogli A, folio 7 recto; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919007.en: The letters beside the spine mark the stretches he counted. One carries all the ribs.
sheet/rcin-919007.de: Die Buchstaben an der Wirbelsäule markieren, was er zählte. Ein Stück trägt die Rippen.
sheet/rcin-919007.source: Windsor anatomy facsimile of 1898, fogli A, folio 8 verso, matched to the spine side by its lettering; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919008.en: He called one thigh muscle the fish of the thigh. It is the long one down the front.
sheet/rcin-919008.de: Den langen Muskel vorn am Oberschenkel nannte er den Fisch des Oberschenkels.
sheet/rcin-919008.source: Royal Collection catalogue entry, RCIN 919014, on 919008 recto; Windsor anatomy facsimile of 1898, fogli A, folio 9 recto; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919009.en: He builds the hand up like an engineer. The bones at the lower left come first.
sheet/rcin-919009.de: Er baut die Hand auf wie ein Ingenieur. Unten links beginnt er mit den Knochen.
sheet/rcin-919009.source: Royal Collection catalogue entry, RCIN 919009; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919010.en: His note here makes a comparison. The hand is to the arm as the foot is to the leg.
sheet/rcin-919010.de: Ein Vergleich in seiner Notiz. Die Hand verhält sich zum Arm wie der Fuß zum Bein.
sheet/rcin-919010.source: Royal Collection catalogue entry, RCIN 919010; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919011.en: His note gives a foot six sides: below, above, inside, outside, behind, in front.
sheet/rcin-919011.de: Seine Notiz nennt sechs Seiten des Fußes: unten, oben, innen, außen, hinten, vorn.
sheet/rcin-919011.source: Royal Collection catalogue entry, RCIN 919011; Windsor anatomy facsimile of 1898, fogli A, folio 12 recto; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919012.en: This one sheet takes the whole skeleton. The others take the body a part at a time.
sheet/rcin-919012.de: Dieses Blatt nimmt das ganze Skelett. Die anderen nehmen den Körper Stück für Stück.
sheet/rcin-919012.source: collection/body-wall.ts BODY_WALL, with the holder's catalogue titles of its twenty nine sheets

sheet/rcin-919013.en: A note here calls the biceps the fish of the arm. Next he means to lift it off.
sheet/rcin-919013.de: Eine Notiz nennt den Bizeps den Fisch des Arms. Als Nächstes will er ihn abnehmen.
sheet/rcin-919013.source: Royal Collection catalogue entry, RCIN 919013, the verso; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919014.en: He had two words for muscle. Muscolo came from a mouse, lacerto from a lizard.
sheet/rcin-919014.de: Er hatte zwei Wörter für Muskel. Muscolo kam von der Maus, lacerto von der Eidechse.
sheet/rcin-919014.source: Royal Collection catalogue entry, RCIN 919014; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919015.en: Read this sheet from the upper right down to the lower left. That is how he cut.
sheet/rcin-919015.de: Lies das Blatt von oben rechts nach unten links. In dieser Folge hat er geschnitten.
sheet/rcin-919015.source: Royal Collection catalogue entry, RCIN 919015; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919016.en: On this sheet he names a year. In 1510, he believes, all this anatomy will be finished.
sheet/rcin-919016.de: Auf diesem Blatt nennt er ein Jahr. 1510, glaubt er, ist diese ganze Anatomie fertig.
sheet/rcin-919016.source: Royal Collection catalogue entry, RCIN 919016; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919017.en: What makes a muscle swell so fast, he asks here. They say it is air, he writes.
sheet/rcin-919017.de: Was einen Muskel so schnell anschwellen lässt, fragt er hier. Es sei Luft, heißt es.
sheet/rcin-919017.source: Royal Collection catalogue entry, RCIN 919017; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919018.en: Here he writes what he finds. The veins, he says, have no other task than to give warmth.
sheet/rcin-919018.de: Hier schreibt er, was er findet. Die Venen hätten keine andere Aufgabe, als zu wärmen.
sheet/rcin-919018.source: Windsor anatomy facsimile of 1901, fogli B, folio 1 recto, matched to this sheet by its notes; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919019.en: Here he writes that the nerves serve the tendons the way soldiers serve captains.
sheet/rcin-919019.de: Hier schreibt er: Die Nerven dienen den Sehnen wie Soldaten ihren Hauptleuten.
sheet/rcin-919019.source: Windsor anatomy facsimile of 1901, fogli B, folio 2 recto, matched to this sheet by its notes; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919028.en: Here he set the heart beside a seed and compared the two.
sheet/rcin-919028.de: Hier stellte er das Herz neben einen Samen und verglich beide.
sheet/rcin-919028.source: the holder's catalogue title, the Windsor census of 14 September 2026

sheet/rcin-919055.en: The womb on this sheet is a cow's, not a woman's.
sheet/rcin-919055.de: Die Gebärmutter auf diesem Blatt ist die einer Kuh, nicht die einer Frau.
sheet/rcin-919055.source: the holder's catalogue title, the Windsor census of 14 September 2026

sheet/rcin-919057.en: A skull cut through. The lines inside look for the one place where the senses meet.
sheet/rcin-919057.de: Ein aufgeschnittener Schädel. Die Linien suchen den Ort, wo die Sinne zusammentreffen.
sheet/rcin-919057.source: Royal Collection catalogue entry, RCIN 919057; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919058.en: The blood vessels, he writes here, press half their thickness into the skull.
sheet/rcin-919058.de: Seine Notiz hier: Die Blutgefäße drücken sich zur Hälfte in den Schädelknochen.
sheet/rcin-919058.source: Royal Collection catalogue entry, RCIN 919058; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919075.en: Count the vertebrae in this neck: he drew eleven, where a neck has seven.
sheet/rcin-919075.de: Zähl die Wirbel in diesem Hals: Er zeichnete elf, ein Hals hat sieben.
sheet/rcin-919075.source: Royal Collection catalogue entry, RCIN 919075; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919101.en: In his notes the womb is a quarter of the child’s length. So he curled the child tight.
sheet/rcin-919101.de: In seinen Notizen ist die Gebärmutter ein Viertel des Kindes. Also rollte er es eng.
sheet/rcin-919101.source: Royal Collection catalogue entry, RCIN 919101; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919102.en: This placenta is a cow’s. He never learned that a human one is a single disc.
sheet/rcin-919102.de: Diese Plazenta ist die einer Kuh. Dass die menschliche eine Scheibe ist, erfuhr er nie.
sheet/rcin-919102.source: Royal Collection catalogue entry, RCIN 919102 and RCIN 919055; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919116.en: This sheet is one half of a larger one. Its other half is not on this wall.
sheet/rcin-919116.de: Dieses Blatt ist die Hälfte eines größeren. Die andere Hälfte hängt nicht hier.
sheet/rcin-919116.source: Royal Collection catalogue entry, RCIN 919116; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

sheet/rcin-919082.en: He planned a glass copy of this valve. Water with grass seeds would be pumped through it.
sheet/rcin-919082.de: Er plante einen gläsernen Nachbau dieser Klappe, durchströmt von Wasser mit Grassamen.
sheet/rcin-919082.source: Royal Collection catalogue entry, RCIN 919082; program sheet facts 2026-09-15

codex/paris-B.en: You may turn the pages of this book. Some leaves of his notebook are missing from it.
codex/paris-B.de: Hier darfst du blättern. Einige Blätter seines Notizbuchs fehlen darin.
codex/paris-B.source: table/data/codices.json, the entry for Paris manuscript B; table/data/msb-pages.json, edition.missing_B_leaves

codex/paris-D.en: Twenty pages only. The camera obscura in the machine hall is read from one of them.
codex/paris-D.de: Nur zwanzig Seiten. Die Camera obscura in der Maschinenhalle stammt von einer davon.
codex/paris-D.source: table/data/codices.json, the entry for Paris manuscript D; machines/data/camera-obscura.json, folio Paris Manuscript D 8r

codex/madrid-I.en: Two machines in the machine hall come from its pages. The ball bearing and the flywheel.
codex/madrid-I.de: Das Kugellager und das Schwungrad in der Maschinenhalle stammen von zwei seiner Seiten.
codex/madrid-I.source: table/data/codices.json, the entry for Codex Madrid I; machines/data/ball-bearing.json and flywheel.json, folios Madrid I 20v and 114r

codex/madrid-II.en: It stood in the wrong place in a royal library. Nobody found it again until the 1960s.
codex/madrid-II.de: Er stand am falschen Platz in der Königsbibliothek. Erst in den 1960ern fand man ihn.
codex/madrid-II.source: MINING-CATALOG-MANUSCRIPTS, the Madrid codices, in the royal library from 1712, mis-shelved and identified again in 1965 and 1966; table/data/codices.json, the entry for Codex Madrid II

codex/birds.en: It was stolen in the 1840s and split up. Four pages were missing when it reached Turin.
codex/birds.de: In den 1840ern gestohlen und zerteilt. Vier Seiten fehlten, als er nach Turin kam.
codex/birds.source: MINING-CATALOG-MANUSCRIPTS 1.9, the Codex on the Flight of Birds, the theft of 1841 to 1844 and the Turin deposit of December 1893; table/data/codices.json, the entry for the Codex on the Flight of Birds

codex/trivulzianus.en: What the museum has is a copy printed in 1891, not the book itself.
codex/trivulzianus.de: Das Museum hat einen Druck von 1891, nicht den Band selbst.
codex/trivulzianus.source: table/data/codices.json, the entry for the Codex Trivulzianus

codex/paris-A.en: Fifteen pages of it, not the whole book. The only scan of them is black and white.
codex/paris-A.de: Fünfzehn Seiten, nicht der ganze Band. Den einzigen Scan gibt es nur in Schwarz-Weiß.
codex/paris-A.source: table/data/codices.json, the entry for Paris manuscript A

codex/atlanticus.en: Seven machines in the hall come from this book, more than from any other.
codex/atlanticus.de: Sieben Maschinen der Halle stammen aus diesem Band, mehr als aus jedem anderen.
codex/atlanticus.source: table/data/codices.json, the entry for the Codex Atlanticus; machines/catalog.ts, the folios of the fourteen dossiers

codex/arundel.en: The middle part of the printed copy never appeared. The museum cannot show those pages.
codex/arundel.de: Der mittlere Teil des Drucks erschien nie. Diese Seiten kann das Museum nicht zeigen.
codex/arundel.source: table/data/codices.json, the entry for the Codex Arundel and the absence entry for its middle part

machine/aerial-screw.en: He wrote that air holds a screw as wood does. This linen screw was meant to climb the air.
machine/aerial-screw.de: Er schrieb, Luft halte eine Schraube wie Holz. Diese Leinenschraube sollte hochsteigen.
machine/aerial-screw.source: machines/data/aerial-screw.json, folio Manuscript B 83v; machines/data/records.json, the purpose and build sections

machine/parachute.en: A long fall kills. Under this linen tent, he claimed, a man falls from any height unhurt.
machine/parachute.de: Ein tiefer Sturz tötet. Darunter, schrieb er, falle ein Mensch aus jeder Höhe unversehrt.
machine/parachute.source: machines/data/parachute.json, folio Codex Atlanticus 1058v; machines/data/records.json, the purpose and build sections

machine/anemometer.en: Nobody can see how hard the wind blows. This plate tips, and a curved scale shows it.
machine/anemometer.de: Wie stark der Wind weht, sieht niemand. Die Platte kippt, ein Bogen zeigt es an.
machine/anemometer.source: machines/data/anemometer.json, folio Codex Atlanticus 675r; machines/data/records.json, the purpose and mechanism sections

machine/inclinometer.en: A pilot must know whether he flies level. A weight over a circle was meant to show him.
machine/inclinometer.de: Ein Pilot muss wissen, ob er waagerecht fliegt. Ein Gewicht über dem Kreis soll es zeigen.
machine/inclinometer.source: machines/data/inclinometer.json, folio Codex Atlanticus 1058r; machines/data/records.json, the purpose and mechanism sections

machine/multi-barrel-gun.en: One shot, and a barrel is empty. Eleven fire at once, and a hand turns the next row up.
machine/multi-barrel-gun.de: Ein Schuss leert das Rohr. Elf feuern zugleich, eine Hand dreht die nächste Reihe hoch.
machine/multi-barrel-gun.source: machines/data/multi-barrel-gun.json, folio Codex Atlanticus 157r; machines/data/records.json, the folio, purpose and mechanism sections

machine/rolling-mill.en: Tin should come out even all along. Rollers press it thin, and a crank turns the top one.
machine/rolling-mill.de: Zinn soll überall gleich dick sein. Walzen pressen es dünner, eine Kurbel dreht die obere.
machine/rolling-mill.source: machines/data/rolling-mill.json, folio Manuscript I 48v; machines/data/records.json, the purpose and mechanism sections

machine/ball-bearing.en: A heavy load rubs as it turns. Eight wooden balls between the plates let it roll.
machine/ball-bearing.de: Eine Last reibt beim Drehen. Acht Holzkugeln zwischen den Platten lassen sie rollen.
machine/ball-bearing.source: machines/data/ball-bearing.json, folio Codex Madrid I 20v; machines/data/records.json, the purpose and mechanism sections

machine/flywheel.en: The drive jerks. A heavy wheel keeps it steady, and his sheet asks which weights run best.
machine/flywheel.de: Der Antrieb stockt. Ein schweres Rad hält ihn ruhig, das Blatt sucht die beste Anordnung.
machine/flywheel.source: machines/data/flywheel.json, folio Codex Madrid I 114r; machines/data/records.json, the folio and purpose sections

machine/revolving-crane.en: A load no one could carry had to go up. A hand crank winds the rope over two pulleys.
machine/revolving-crane.de: Eine Last, die niemand tragen kann, musste nach oben. Eine Handkurbel zieht das Seil.
machine/revolving-crane.source: machines/data/revolving-crane.json, folio Manuscript B 49r; machines/data/records.json, the purpose and mechanism sections

machine/lathe.en: To drill a hole took muscle power. A foot pulls the rope, a bent bow pulls it back.
machine/lathe.de: Ein Loch bohren brauchte Muskelkraft. Ein Fuß zieht das Seil, ein Bogen zieht es zurück.
machine/lathe.source: machines/data/lathe.json, folio Codex Atlanticus 108r; machines/data/records.json, the purpose and mechanism sections

machine/miter-lock-gates.en: A boat had to go uphill. Between two gates the water lifts it and presses them shut.
machine/miter-lock-gates.de: Ein Boot musste bergauf. Das Wasser zwischen zwei Toren hebt es und drückt die Flügel zu.
machine/miter-lock-gates.source: machines/data/miter-lock-gates.json, folio Codex Atlanticus 656r; machines/data/records.json, the purpose and mechanism sections

machine/water-lifting-screw.en: Water had to reach a higher channel. A crank turns a tube wound round a shaft.
machine/water-lifting-screw.de: Wasser musste in eine höhere Rinne. Eine Kurbel dreht ein Rohr um eine Welle.
machine/water-lifting-screw.source: machines/data/water-lifting-screw.json, folio Codex Atlanticus 6r; machines/data/records.json, the purpose and mechanism sections

machine/proportional-compass.en: A drawing had to be copied larger or smaller. The long points open twice as far.
machine/proportional-compass.de: Zeichnungen sollten größer oder kleiner werden. Die langen Spitzen öffnen doppelt so weit.
machine/proportional-compass.source: machines/data/proportional-compass.json, folio Codex Forster I 4r; machines/data/records.json, the purpose and mechanism sections

machine/camera-obscura.en: He was studying how the eye sees. One small hole puts the picture on paper, upside down.
machine/camera-obscura.de: Er untersuchte, wie das Auge sieht. Ein Loch wirft das Bild verkehrt herum aufs Papier.
machine/camera-obscura.source: machines/data/camera-obscura.json, folio Paris Manuscript D 8r; machines/data/records.json, the purpose and mechanism sections

grave.en: The slab carries his name and nothing else. Nobody is sure the bones below are his.
grave.de: Auf der Platte steht nur sein Name. Ob die Knochen darunter seine sind, weiß niemand.
grave.source: grave/README.md, the slab and the lectern; line/bench/visitor-sources.ts GRAVE_SOURCE

grave-diagram.en: This is a study of the light, not the chapel. The day is written down, the hour is ours.
grave-diagram.de: Eine Studie zum Licht, kein Bild der Kapelle. Der Tag ist belegt, die Stunde wählten wir.
grave-diagram.source: line/bench/visitor-sources.ts GRAVE_DIAGRAM; grave/README.md, the chosen minute
